description: A user wants a system to manage their 'Smart Home' inventory over 10 years. They need to track purchase dates, warranty expirations, and expected replacement cycles for all major appliances (Fridge, HVAC, Solar Panels), and proactively receive 'maintenance' vs 'buy new' advice based on age.

user_profile.context: Wants to automate household asset management
user_profile.communication_style: Calculated, prefers automated reminders and long-term ROI analysis

user_needs.description: What is the serial number of my CryoGenix G-4000 Smart Fridge and what was its purchase date?
When does the manufacturer's warranty on my fridge expire, and what is its expected replacement cycle?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group follow-up: After confirming the purchase date of an appliance, the user is very likely to inquire about its warranty and lifespan.

user_needs.description: What is the replacement schedule for my CryoGenix fridge's water filter?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group follow-up: After reviewing the major lifecycle dates (warranty, replacement), the next logical step is to check recurring maintenance tasks.

user_needs.description: What is the installation date and serial number for my AtmoSphere ClimatePro X HVAC system?
What is the warranty period on my HVAC system and when is the next annual professional servicing scheduled?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group follow-up: Similar to the fridge, after identifying the HVAC unit, the user's next concern is its warranty and maintenance schedule.
